name: Starburst

features.name: Starburst wilds
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 expand and trigger a respin, up to three in a row.

review:
The definition of low volatility: lots of small wins, one feature, and a 500x cap. Starburst wilds land on the middle reels, expand, and give you a respin – and wins pay both ways.

It's still the best reference for what 'low volatility' actually feels like, and it looks as clean and readable as ever. 96.09% RTP. Not a game for big wins, but a relaxing one.
